title: Asian Shares Rise, Treasuries Steady Before Warsh: Markets Wrap
summary: Asian shares posted a modest gain, while US stock futures slipped, as traders avoided big bets before Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh’s Jackson Hole speech for clues on the path of interest rates. Treasuries held their losses.

title: CanSino CEO Xuefeng Yu on Earnings, Pipeline
summary: Xuefeng Yu, Chairman & CEO of CanSino Biologics, discusses the Chinese vaccine maker's first-half results and clinical pipeline. He speaks exclusively on "Bloomberg: The China Show." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Inside India's AI Ambitions
summary: India's big AI bet is backed by government incentives and investments from global tech giants, and it's aiming to become a key hub in the AI economy. Bloomberg's Saritha Rai reports on whether it can translate this massive spending into a lasting advantage. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Top Sydney Builder’s $2.3 Billion Debt Woes Hit Private Credit
summary: Bathla Group, a major property developer in Sydney, is leaving private credit investors exposed after falling into insolvency earlier this week in the latest blow to Australia’s troubled housing market.

title: Billionare and Philantropist Chaudhary on the Scale of Nepal's Flood Disaster
summary: Nepalese industrialist Binod Chaudhary speaks with Bloomberg's Haslinda Amin about the scale of the humanitarian disaster facing his country, and how his conglomerate is working with the government to improve the situation. (Source: Bloomberg)
